# Pavan Kumar — Professional Portfolio

> Business Analyst specializing in AI Automation, Voice AI, LLMs, and Enterprise Automation.

## About
Pavan Kumar is a Business Analyst based in Bengaluru, India. He builds enterprise AI applications, real-time Voice AI assistants (Aria), multi-tenant e-Invoicing pipelines, and sales automation agents.

## Stack & Skills
- **Languages:** Python, SQL
- **AI & ML:** LLMs, Groq LLaMA, Whisper, Pipecat, RAG, Voice AI
- **Enterprise Automation:** Microsoft Graph API, Google Workspace APIs, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Power BI, Odoo CRM, IBM RPA, N8n
